field.label: Enable Telegram
field.help: Send selected system notifications to Telegram independently of MAX and Gotify.

field.label: Bot token
field.help: Create a Telegram bot using @BotFather and enter its token. Do not share this token.

field.label: Chat ID
field.help: Enter a numeric personal/group chat ID or the public channel username. The bot must have permission to send to that destination.

field.label: Forum topic ID
field.help: Enter the topic ID when sending to a specific topic in a Telegram forum group. Leave empty for other chats.
